data-journey-unblur="true" class="css-hszlh4 e11ghb4g3"><p data-journey-content="true" data-node-id="recipe-intro.0" class="css-1ood0zq emevuu60"><em>Hasselbackspotatis, </em>aka Hasselback potatoes, are a Swedish invention that transforms a humble <a href="https://www.delish.com/cooking/recipe-ideas/a22553662/how-to-bake-a-potato-in-the-oven/" target="_self" data-vars-ga-outbound-link="https://www.delish.com/cooking/recipe-ideas/a22553662/how-to-bake-a-potato-in-the-oven/" data-vars-ga-ux-element="Hyperlink" data-vars-ga-call-to-action="baked potato" class="body-link css-8bav6j emevuu60">baked potato</a> into an ingenious work of art. Each <a href="https://www.delish.com/cooking/recipe-ideas/g3030/potato-recipes/" target="_self" data-vars-ga-outbound-link="https://www.delish.com/cooking/recipe-ideas/g3030/potato-recipes/" data-vars-ga-ux-element="Hyperlink" data-vars-ga-call-to-action="potato" class="body-link css-8bav6j emevuu60">potato</a> is partially sliced into a row of thin slivers that then get brushed with oil or butter and baked to roasty-toasty crispy-crunchy perfection. For lovers of baked potatoes and <a href="https://www.delish.com/food-news/g20667311/best-potato-chips-ranked/" target="_self" data-vars-ga-outbound-link="https://www.delish.com/food-news/g20667311/best-potato-chips-ranked/" data-vars-ga-ux-element="Hyperlink" data-vars-ga-call-to-action="potato chips" class="body-link css-8bav6j emevuu60">potato chips</a>, the Hasselback potato is going to be a taste of spud heaven.</p><p data-journey-content="true" data-node-id="recipe-intro.1" class="css-1ood0zq emevuu60">Here are some key tips for making the most beautiful and delicious Hasselback potatoes:</p><p data-journey-content="true" data-node-id="recipe-intro.2" class="css-1ood0zq emevuu60"><strong>What is the easiest way to cut Hasselback potatoes?</strong></p><p data-journey-content="true" data-node-id="recipe-intro.3" class="css-1ood0zq emevuu60">Use a sharp knife to make very thin cuts as close to each other as possible—ideally 1/8" apart. The tighter your cuts, the more fanning action will happen as the potato bakes.</p><p data-journey-content="true" data-node-id="recipe-intro.4" class="css-1ood0zq emevuu60"><strong>Are there any tools I should use?</strong></p><p data-journey-content="true" data-node-id="recipe-intro.5" class="css-1ood0zq emevuu60">Use a pair of chopsticks as safety guards! Situate your potato between a pair of chopsticks—they will prevent your knife from slicing all the way through the potato. You want to make sure there's 1/2" of intact potato on the bottom for structural integrity. If you accidentally slice all the way through, don't worry! Skewer together the pieces with a toothpick and bake as if nothing went wrong—just make sure to take out the toothpick before serving!</p><p data-journey-content="true" data-node-id="recipe-intro.6" class="css-1ood0zq emevuu60"><strong>How long should I bake them for?</strong></p><p data-journey-content="true" data-node-id="recipe-intro.7" class="css-1ood0zq emevuu60">Depending on the size of your potatoes, they may need 10 minutes more or less than the suggested cooking times below. Keep roasting until the fanned out tips of the potatoes are nicely golden and crispy, and the potato as a whole is fork-tender with no resistance.</p><p data-journey-content="true" data-node-id="recipe-intro.8" class="css-1ood0zq emevuu60"><strong>What should I top them with?</strong></p><p data-journey-content="true" data-node-id="recipe-intro.9" class="css-1ood0zq emevuu60">You do you! I love cream cheese, I love <a href="https://www.delish.com/cooking/recipe-ideas/a33954464/everything-bagel-pasta-recipe/" target="_self" data-vars-ga-outbound-link="https://www.delish.com/cooking/recipe-ideas/a33954464/everything-bagel-pasta-recipe/" data-vars-ga-ux-element="Hyperlink" data-vars-ga-call-to-action="everything bagel seasoning" class="body-link css-8bav6j emevuu60">everything bagel seasoning</a>, and I love crunchy raw onions as well as hot sauce. So I decided to put it all on top of my baked potato: a creamy cream cheese sauce balanced out by Sriracha, sprinkled with all of the above. Whatever you fancy will do for a delicious topping—any cheese with crushed bacon bits, sour cream, chili flakes, or even a drizzle of salad dressing!<br/><br/>If you've made this recipe, let us know
